<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Domination''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国による統治</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意のロケーション上に配備する。自分がそのロケーションを支配している時に、そこでフォース消耗を行わなかったなら、相手は次のターン、そこでフォースを発生させることができない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Imperial-Domination-PSA-83063559.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ベイダーの軍が各地に皇帝の勅命の威光を示す時、反乱軍の資源と命脈はあっけなく閉ざされてしまう。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial Domination.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any location. If you control that location and did not Force drain there, the opponent cannot generate Force there on the next turn.

'''Lore:'''
When Vader's army shows the prestige of the Emperor's edict in various places, Rebel resources and lifelines are quickly shut off.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Opponent generates no Force is フォースを発生させることができない.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Domination]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
